concepts.prompt: A wide rectangular plank boardwalk terrace for a marsh village: a flat deck of weathered driftwood planks raised about 0.6 m on many short stubby driftwood piles, a low rope rail strung between short posts along two sides, two or three standing woven reed-mat screens in light timber frames at one back corner, a short three-plank step on the front edge, a couple of rope coils and a small reed basket on the deck. Mostly open flat walkable deck. Real size about 8 m by 6 m footprint, deck 0.6 m high, screens about 2 m tall. Three-quarter elevated view. Stylised Palworld/Animo-class game prop concept, same family as the attached Tidewake woven reed hall and dock shelter: chunky readable shapes, warm sun-bleached weathered driftwood timber, golden woven reed and thatch, sun-bleached rope bindings, teal and sea-blue paint accents, cream sailcloth, clean hand-painted PBR finish. Use the attached boards only for palette, mood and finish quality. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no crimson, no maroon anywhere. Single isolated object, full object visible, plain neutral light background, no text, no labels, no people, no creatures.

concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 0 only, single-image model): 3/4 view of plank deck on teal-stained piles, rope rail on two sides, reed-mat screens and basket; views 1-2 disagreed on rails and steps so were not used

visual_verdict: Good: weathered plank deck on short teal-stained driftwood piles, rope rail on two sides, two framed woven reed screens about 2.3 m tall at one corner, low plank steps at both short ends, rope coils and a reed basket. At 8 m width the footprint is 8 x 5.88 m; overall height 3.45 m (screens). Deck top measures about 0.8-0.9 m above the base, higher than the 0.6 m brief: sink it about 0.25 m into ground/water or scale Y in the scene. Mostly open flat deck suited as a walkable forecourt (collision is the lane's job).
integration_note: candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed: driftwood, golden reed, rope, teal pile stain
